name: trading-analysis-agent
description: Personal portfolio + watchlist web app with live market data and multi-agent AI analysis (Gemini primary, Claude fallback). Google Sheets storage, Cloudflare Workers hosting.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n worker,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @taa/worker" "npm run dev -w @taa/web"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @taa/worker
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
